name: scriptune
description: Root launcher for the Scriptune API, web app, mobile app, and local Whisper transcriber.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix packages/contracts install && npm --prefix api install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix mobile install && npm run setup:transcriber
scripts.setup:transcriber: python3 -m venv transcriber/.venv && transcriber/.venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && transcriber/.venv/bin/pip install -r transcriber/requirements.txt && transcriber/.venv/bin/python -c "import whisper; whisper.load_model('tiny')"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix packages/contracts run typecheck && npm --prefix api run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix mobile run typecheck
